duration.value: instantaneous DESCRIPTION Time to act gives you the time to perform a single skill check. The skill check must be an actual action, you must have at least one rank in the skill; all necessary equipment must be on your person and ready to use. Skill checks that require extensive time (over 1 minute) or bulk materials cannot be used with this spell. The skill check cannot be a reaction to outside actions or the actions of others. During the action, you cannot move from your current position but you can perform any other physical aspects of the skill use. You cannot make use of any spell, supernatural or even extraordinary ability-related skill check. To others you seem to blur and then the action is complete.
